listing.name: Madden NFL 08 (Xbox 360) — MaddenNFL08-Recompiled (anishchandra24)
listing.summary: Upstream reports testing this early native port on two PCs. Countdown beeps are missing in the 40-yard dash; vector aliasing and texture-mip fixes are documented. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own extracted disc folder with title ID 4541081D. default.xex must be 20529152 bytes with SHA-256 962EA344FB966E1BE1C94667D4213A309A69A821AE3BEC0CB2FCA4166ECC6627.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the installer or local source-build instructions with the pinned patched ReXGlue, Visual Studio 2022 Community, Clang, CMake and Ninja. Use Windows x64 with Direct3D 12 ROV support.

warnings: Upstream reports testing this early native port on two PCs. Countdown beeps are missing in the 40-yard dash; vector aliasing and texture-mip fixes are documented.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
